root_idea.summary: The root centers on fastening, binding, and firm connectedness.
root_idea.development: From physically tying or joining things, the semantic range develops toward binding agreements and obligations, firm mental adherence, consolidation, and things becoming compact or firmly established.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form.
Displayed as the distinct Form II verb.
Displayed under the singular nominal citation form.
The Quranic plural is presented under its supported singular citation form عَقْد.

senses.definition: To bind, conclude, or ratify a covenant, agreement, or comparable obligation.
senses.usage_conditions: In 4:33, the expression concerns a binding or ratifying relationship expressed through oaths or right hands; the Quranic occurrence is a feminine perfect form.

senses.definition: To bind, confirm, or make binding an oath.
senses.usage_conditions: The Form II occurrence refers specifically to binding or confirming oaths; the doubled form may express intensified or deliberate binding without requiring a separate lexical branch.

senses.definition: A binding bond or contract, especially the marriage bond.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of a bond or obligation that has been formed or ratified; the Quranic occurrences in al-Baqarah concern the marriage bond.

senses.definition: A knot or impediment in speech.
senses.usage_conditions: In 20:27, the knot is figurative: a restraint or impediment affecting fluent speech.
In the expression النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ, the plural denotes knots made or used by sorceresses in magical practice.

senses.definition: Contracts, covenants, agreements, or other binding obligations.
senses.usage_conditions: This plural noun can include contractual arrangements and, in religious usage, obligations or ordinances imposed by God or mutually undertaken in accordance with religion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To tie, knot, fasten, or make firm, especially a cord or rope.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The basic physical action is contrasted with loosening and may also be applied to tying a banner.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To arrange beard or hair into knots or curls.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional grooming or war-related use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To exert and prepare oneself for action.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use based on tying or securing a rope.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become angry and prepare to do mischief.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic expression literally referring to knotting the forelock.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To have recourse to someone for refuge or protection.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic, figurative construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To count or reckon by bending and extending the fingers.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object may be the calculation itself or the fingers used in counting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To close or cling fast during sexual coupling.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized physiological or sexual construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be restrained from attacking by means of charms or talismans.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or magical usage reported in traditional expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put a crown upon the head.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional construction with the crown as object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To arch or vault a building, and to cement it with gypsum.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A constructional use referring to forming or securing an arched structure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a plant to form and compact its fruit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of fruit developing into a compact formation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To produce or form fat and flesh; for fat to become formed and compact.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of pasture in relation to the fat or flesh produced by grazing animals, and of fat itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To thicken or become inspissated.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of liquids such as rob, tar, honey, and date juice, commonly through boiling.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For the belly to become constipated.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A bodily resultative use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To have an impediment in the tongue; to be tongue-tied.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The impediment may make free speech difficult.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For sand to become moistened and cohere.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A resultative use describing sand after heavy rain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To impose an obligation or require an undertaking or security.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with an object such as a tax, obligation, engagement, or security.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To settle or determine the heart or mind firmly upon something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative binding of one's resolve or adherence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To tie many things into knots, especially forelocks or mane hair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The Form II conveys repeated or multiple knotting in the cited construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make speech or language obscure.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative Form II use, as though the speech had been made knotty.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To unite with another in a contract, covenant, compact, treaty, or engagement.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction takes the other party as its object and concerns mutual agreement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To thicken or cause a liquid to become inspissated.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of rob, tar, honey, and similar substances by boiling.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become gathered into an arched or constructed form.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a rainbow resembling an arch and of a collection of clouds.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For the inner casing of a well to project below while the upper part recedes.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical description of the structure of a well.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To accumulate, congest, or become compacted into lumps.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of sand and moist earth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a wound or ulcer to form into a knot or lump.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A resultative medical use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To enter jointly into a contract, covenant, treaty, or engagement.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The reciprocal Form VI describes parties agreeing among themselves.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For animals to become locked together in sexual coupling.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized reciprocal construction used of dogs.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a cord or rope to become tied, knotted, or firmly fastened.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The intransitive Form VII describes the resulting state.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a sale, marriage, contract, or compact to be concluded, settled, or ratified.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of an agreement becoming effective or established.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For an animal's tail to become twisted.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A physical resultative use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For hair to become knotted, crisp, or curly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of hair acquiring a compact or twisted form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For dates or other fruit to become organized and compact.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A resultative botanical use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To hold something firmly in the heart or mind; to believe or be certain of it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Especially used of religious doctrines and firmly held convictions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To acquire, buy, or collect property or an estate.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The acquired property may consist of land, houses, or other assets.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To adopt someone as a brother in God.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional social or religious relationship.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make pearls, beads, or similar items into a necklace.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative arrangement of separate items into a connected string.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a date-stone or other thing to become hard.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A resultative use describing hardening.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For fraternity or a bond between people to become true, sincere, and firmly established.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a relationship becoming securely grounded.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To shut or lock a door upon oneself in order to die.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare, attributed lexical usage with a variant reported by other authorities.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a female animal to desire the male.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form X use reported of a sow.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Responsibility, accountability, or suretiship.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal extension of binding obligation; synonymous with ضَمَانٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An arch, vault, or curved architectural structure.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural may denote arches or vaulted structures.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A decimal number from ten through ninety.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical numerical use; the plural is عُقُودٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A necklace or string on which beads are strung.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal object worn around the neck, including a necklace for a child.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A twist or knot-like formation in an animal's tail or horn.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of the tail of a sheep or goat and the horn of a he-goat.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Canker, corrosion, decay, or blackness in a tooth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized dental term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Compact, accumulated, or clumped earth or sand.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of moist earth and of sand that has accumulated or congested.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A meadow whose herbage is continuous or uninterrupted.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A descriptive epithet for dense, continuous vegetation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Short, strong, and enduring in labor, when applied to a camel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival use describing the camel's build or endurance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A tree or wooded growth that provides sufficient sustenance or pasture.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also applied to a place rich in trees or palms and useful as grazing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The star called a Piscium.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized astronomical name explained through the idea of a knot or junction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A figurative knot whose loosening denotes the calming of anger.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In the idiom تحلّلت عقده, the knots are metaphorical.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Judgment, deliberation, or competence in managing affairs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used idiomatically of strength or weakness in a person's judgment and administration.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A ratified pledge of obedience or allegiance, and by extension a governorship or prefecture.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of authority or office established through a binding pledge.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A node, joint, articulation, or uneven juncture of a bone or finger.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes a protuberant or irregularly set bone and the joints or phalanges of the fingers.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A knot or node in a cane, tree, horn, or mountain structure.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a structural point or knot-like formation in various natural objects.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A plant node, bud, or compact roundish fruiting body.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plant node is the point from which a leaf emerges; the term also covers certain compact plant growths.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A node or intersection of a planet's path.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the dual expression for the two planetary nodes.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A small nodular lump, ganglion, gland, or knob.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A general anatomical or physical use for a compact protuberance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The enlarged, locked penis of a dog during copulation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized anatomical term restricted to the stated physiological condition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An estate or property consisting of land, houses, palms, or revenue-producing holdings.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The estate is understood as an acquired possession.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A wooded or herbage-rich place, a garden of palms, or dependable pasture.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may denote land, trees, or remaining pasture sufficient for animals.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Anything on which a person relies and through which he feels established or adequately provided for.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Often realized as sufficient property or an estate.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The thick root or base of the tongue.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A species or variety of dates.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized botanical or agricultural noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person united with another in a contract or covenant; a confederate.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used figuratively of someone bound by nature to generosity or meanness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Thick, thickened, or inspissated.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used adjectivally of rob, honey, and similar substances.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A firmly held belief, creed, doctrine, or religious tenet.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun denotes what a person holds firmly in the heart or mind, especially without doubt.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A she-camel that has conceived and twists or holds her tail as though tying it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The bodily sign indicates conception after mating.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A gazelle that twists its tail or bends its neck in a characteristic posture.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term covers several described postures, including lying down or raising the head protectively.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who twists his neck out of pride.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic description of proud bearing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Thoroughly cooked and reduced food from which the water has gone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied particularly to a cooked preparation called أَقِط.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The protected space or surrounding area of a well.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical geographical use referring to the well's ḥarīm and its surroundings.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A raceme or bunch of grapes, dates, or similar fruit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A botanical noun for fruit borne together in a cluster.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An animal having a twisted or knot-like tail or a knot in its horn.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to wolves, dogs, rams, sheep, goats, and similar animals; the feminine form is also used.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Tongue-tied or unable to speak freely.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival counterpart to the verbal description of a speech impediment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Mean and difficult or stubborn in disposition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression لَئِيمٌ أَعْقَدُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A female slave.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized lexical use of the feminine form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The place where something is tied, joined, or knotted; figuratively, a person's near standing or a point where qualities are joined.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes the idioms مَعْقِدَ الإِزَارِ and مَعَاقِدِ العِزِّ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A joint, articulation, or place of juncture between two bones.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical use closely related to the notion of a joining point.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A garment or textile associated with the manufacture of Hجر.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized traditional term recorded in a transmitted expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Tied in many knots or made intricately knotty.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The doubled form marks multiplicity or abundance of knots.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Obscure or rendered difficult to understand.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied figuratively to language that has been made knotty or intricate.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An enchanter or magician who ties knots as part of sorcery.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The occupational sense derives from the practice of knotting magical cords or threads.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Tied, knotted, or firmly fastened, especially a cord or rope.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The passive participle describes the resulting secured state.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Firmly attached or cleaving, as good fortune is said to cleave to horses' forelocks.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative idiom based on something being tied to or inseparable from another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sale, contract, compact, or similar agreement that has been concluded or ratified.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The passive participle is used substantively of an agreement in force.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A settled or determined opinion or judgment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In the expression ليس له معقود, the noun denotes an established view.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Arched, vaulted, or furnished with arches.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a building or structure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An oath binding a person to do or refrain from doing something in the future.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical legal expression for a future-oriented binding oath.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Honey thickened by fire, or food or wheat thickened with honey.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized culinary noun.

lane_unit_coverage.note: The cementing construction is grouped with the related architectural use.
The compacting of fat is grouped with the closely related fat-forming use.
A second physiological expression of the same sexual-locking branch.
Rare attributed usage retained as a lexical branch.
Synonymic pointer without new lexical content.

cautions: The public Form I headword is normalized from the Quranic feminine perfect form عَقَدَتْ to the dictionary citation form عَقَدَ.
The Quranic noun عُقْدَة spans distinct contexts of a marriage bond, a speech impediment, and sorcery knots; these are separated above.
